subject.title: fix: resolve response prefix template variables in abort replies

question: Should maintainers repair this stale external branch, ask the contributor to rebase and address the routed/session-state blockers, or replace it with a fresh narrow PR?
rationale: The fix is useful and proof-positive, but the branch is dirty and the remaining correctness gaps cross routed delivery and active model-state ownership.

options.title: Require focused repair before merge
options.body: Update or replace the branch so routed abort delivery receives prefix context and abort prefixes use active model/thinking state before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor rebase
options.body: Keep the PR waiting on the author until the contributor rebases and addresses the existing blockers on the source branch.

options.title: Accept config-default mitigation
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally merge only the config-default improvement, but that would leave the linked bug partially fixed for routed and overridden sessions.

recommendation.title: Require focused repair before merge
recommendation.body: Update or replace the branch so routed abort delivery receives prefix context and abort prefixes use active model/thinking state before merge.
